android.desc:
⚔️ WORD FIGHTER — REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER WORD BATTLES

Two to four players. One shared grid. Five minutes to prove you're better with words than everyone else in the room.

There's no letter rack and no hidden hand. On your turn you drop a single letter anywhere on the board, then swipe across connected cells to claim any word you can find. Claimed cells lock in your colour. Chain several words in one turn and the combo bonus stacks up fast.

The catch: everyone is building on the same grid. Every letter you place is a letter your opponents can use too.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
• Place one letter anywhere on the shared grid
• Swipe across connected cells to claim words
• Land on double-letter, triple-letter and double-word cells to multiply your score
• Highest score when the board fills up wins

🃏 23 POWER CARDS
This is where it stops being polite. Equip a power deck and carry it into every match:
• ATTACK — Freeze their clock, Stun their turn, Cell Bomb a letter they needed, Line Buster five cells at once, Score Raid their best word, Letter Lock the cell they were saving
• DEFENCE — Shield an incoming attack, Mirror it back at the sender, Bomb Diffuser a wrecked cell, Line Healer to repair five at once
• UTILITY — Hint to reveal hidden words, Time Warp for 20 extra seconds, Multiplier to double a turn, Two Letters to place twice, Undo to take a move back

Cards unlock across seven tiers — Rookie, Adept, Skirmisher, Tactician, Striker, Master and Grandmaster — earned with XP from playing.

🏟️ ALWAYS SOMEONE TO PLAY
• PUBLIC ROOMS — live rooms running around the clock. Filter by Speed, Long Words, High Stakes or Normal, plus grid size and player count
• PRIVATE GAMES — create a room and share a six-character code or QR. No friend requests, no accounts to add
• BOT PRACTICE — sharpen placement against an adjustable-difficulty bot without risking your rating

📅 DAILY PUZZLE
One grid a day, identical for every player on the planet. How many words can you pull out of it before the timer dies? Finish for a spoiler-free result card built for the group chat, a spot on the daily leaderboard, and a streak you'll refuse to break.

📊 PROGRESSION THAT ACTUALLY MOVES
• Skill rating that decides who the matchmaker puts you against
• League points and five leaderboard views: global, weekly, monthly, seasonal and friends-only
• Daily quests that refresh every morning
• Achievements for the long haul
• XP from wins, streaks, perfect games and daily
